== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Mari is a young girl, approximately ten years of age, who serves as the designated bait for her companion, [[Shera]]. Due to her large eyes and long, curly hair, Mari possesses a vulnerable appearance that often leads strangers to believe she is in distress. Within their partnership, Mari adopts a maternal role toward [[Shera]], acting as a caretaker who manages her companion's safety and provides guidance on when to feel fear. Despite her role as bait, she is capable of assisting others by reporting findings or asking questions during investigations.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Mari is a girl whose body was found slumped against a cage. Her corpse was later viewed by her friend, [[Shera]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|As a friend to [[Shera]], Mari possessed a compassionate nature. She held the desire for the man wearing an apron to be spared.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Mari served in a specialized role as the [[Bait]] during killing operations.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Mari served as the [[Bait]] during killing operations. During one such mission, she was shot in the chest by Rudeus Maxwell{{!}}Maxwell and her body was found slumped against a cage. Although she played her role as [[Bait]], she would have preferred that the man in the apron be spared. Her corpse was later seen by [[Shera]].}}
